summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the title format entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (terminal check only, returns bool); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md adds an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests, mypy, and Black were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed.
